mission.name: Imazu 03 -- overtaking (own-ship give-way)
mission.description: Canonical Imazu problem 3, reproduced from Sawada et al. (2021) Table 4 (J. Mar. Sci. Technol. 26(2), 509-524) -- exact published own-ship/target start positions (NM), headings (deg), and speeds (kn), so results are directly comparable against other papers using the same published Imazu problem set. ts1 is a slower target ahead that own-ship must overtake.
pass_criteria: Own-ship keeps clear of the slower target it is overtaking and does not cut in front until finally past and clear.
Minimum CPA to ALL targets stays above the safe-distance threshold.

evaluation.verdict: FAIL -- did not reach the goal
